model_annotation_dish_description: Detect the dish and retain its boundary regions. If detection fails, annotate the full image.
model_annotation_dish_label: Skip empty areas outside the dish
model_annotation_placeholder: Describe the bodies an AI agent should mark for each class, and what to leave out.
models_description: Each model names the classes it counts; its datasets train ever more accurate versions.
models_empty_description: Create a model to name the classes it counts.
version_dialog_effect: Once current, the observation images of this model are counted again by it; reviewed and AI-proposed counts stay as they are. Any other version can be chosen back at any time, and its counts return at once without reading again.
version_dialog_failed: {count} images could not be read and are left out of the comparison.

match.hasCurrent=no: Compared with the reviewers' counts on {formattedCount} reviewed images this version never trained on. Lower error is better. This model has no current version yet; only this version's results are shown.
match.hasCurrent=*: Compared with the reviewers' counts on {formattedCount} reviewed images this version never trained on. Lower error is better.

version_dialog_images_description: Version columns show the difference from the reviewers' count; the images either version miscounts most come first.
version_dialog_no_comparison: This version has no held-out validation images, so it cannot be compared with the current one.
version_dialog_reading: Still reading: this version {candidate}/{total}, current version {current}/{total}. Results count only the images both have read.
version_dialog_waiting: The comparison appears here once the images are read, which needs a Worker online.
versions_empty_description: A version appears here when a training run succeeds.
